name: Express Entry — Canadian Experience Class (CEC)

selection_odds.basis: 2026 CEC-specific draw cutoffs have run in a narrow 514-518 CRS band since April 2026; CEC is the largest single ITA source in 2026, roughly 45% of all invitations issued across 13 CEC draws by early August

requirements.blocker_text: This requires at least 1 year of skilled Canadian work experience (TEER 0/1/2/3) within the past 3 years.
This requires CLB 7 for TEER 0/1 occupations, or CLB 5 for TEER 2/3 occupations. No education requirement.
requirements.fix_path: Take an approved language test at the required level.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a CRS score in the range recent CEC draws have used — a narrow 514-518 band since April 2026.
requirements.fix_path: Improve CRS-scoring factors before submitting or resubmitting a profile.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 1+ year skilled Canadian work experience

sources.title: Express Entry rounds of invitations - IRCC

notes: CORRECTION TO AN INITIAL RESEARCH ASSUMPTION, flagged honestly: the CEC base experience requirement remains 1 year, unchanged — the '6 to 12 months' increase referenced during research refers only to the SEPARATE category-based selection mechanism's minimum qualifying experience for renewed categories in 2026, not to CEC itself. Genuinely the dominant Express Entry pathway by volume in 2026 (~45% of all invitations across 13 draws by early August) — the practical center of gravity for Canada's economic immigration system this year, given the near-total absence of general draws. CRS cutoffs are explicitly modeled as a dated snapshot rather than a fixed rule — this figure WILL move with each new draw and should be re-verified against the live IRCC rounds table before being treated as current.
